response: "When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to 1962, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old serial killer case. The notorious 'Timekeeper' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensic techniques is the only hope for catching him. As she navigates the unfamiliar world of 1960s America, Rachel must use her skills to leave subtle clues that will aid her modern colleagues in tracking down the killer. With the Timekeeper's next victim already in his sights, Rachel must work against the clock to prevent a catastrophe. Can she use her knowledge of the future to outsmart the killer and bring him to justice, or will she become the Timekeeper's next victim? The clock is ticking, and the stakes are higher than ever. 1.
